import pandas as pd, re
df = pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=None)
header = df.iloc[4].tolist()
data = df.iloc[5:].copy()
data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in header]
# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
data = data[data['Visit ID'].notna()]
# Normalize village
def norm_v(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    s = str(s).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
data['Village_norm'] = data['Village'].apply(norm_v)
# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
data_dedup = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# Normalize district for comparison? Keep case-insensitive
def norm_d(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()
data_dedup['District_norm'] = data_dedup['District'].apply(norm_d)
count = data_dedup[data_dedup['District_norm']=='gadchiroli'].shape[0]
print('total rows', len(data))
print('dedup rows', len(data_dedup))
print('count gadchiroli', count)
print(data_dedup[data_dedup['District_norm']=='gadchiroli'][['Visit ID','District','Village']].head(20))
\""
